a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan only works if no storm hits in rounds 1 and 2, which gives each of us about a 4% chance. The reserve's 4 cells can fully save one of us right now. Please don't also take, because a random split could leave us both short. After I take, I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so you have the best chance I can give you to reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
